denial_reason: The records submitted do not document an objective neurological deficit.

docs.author: Dr. Samuel Oyelaran
sentences: Patient is a 33-year-old woman with low back pain for about four months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
She started physical therapy three weeks ago.
Pain radiates down the right leg to the foot.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1036 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document an objective neurological deficit. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
